messages:
maria: Hi team — I pushed changes addressing the review comments on PR #1487. Key points: adjusted retry backoff, added unit test for failure path, updated CHANGELOG, and removed the experimental flag.

sam: thanks! quick q: did you keep the old behavior behind a config? we rely on it in one integration.

maria: yep, there's a toggle in config; default is preserved. added note in README under 'config' section.

nathan: lgtm for the retry code, left one tiny nit inline about renaming a var (see comment). otherwise :+1:

maria: nice catch — renamed to 'backoffMs' and force-pushed. also squashed the fixups.

ci-bot: CI pipeline: unit tests ✅ | integration tests running (eta ~8m) — https://ci.internal/runs/987654

ira: will do a quick run of the integration tests locally and report back in ~20m.

emma: PTAL from docs side when you get a sec — README change looks fine at a glance.

sam: i'm +1 on merging after integration tests; if ira doesn't flag anything, go ahead and merge.

ira: integration passed locally for me, no regressions observed. 👍

maria: thanks all — re-requesting review to get final approve so I can merge before EOD. tagging @sam @nathan @emma

nathan: approving now, going to squash and merge if CI stays green. :shipit:

ci-bot: integration tests ✅ | deploy staging triggered

maria: merged — thanks everyone. I'll watch canary and open a follow-up if anything pops up.
